event_records.description: Marguerite sees the one-star review on the major review site.

marguerite.name: Marguerite
marguerite.persona_brief:
You are Marguerite.
Marguerite is the owner of the Copper Kettle bistro. She usually replies to reviews within days, often defensively. She knows the bistro was short two servers on the night in question.

resolution.question: A one-star review of the Copper Kettle bistro went up on a major review site last night. Will the owner post a public reply within a week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Marguerite posted a public reply to the review on the major review site before 2026-09-06T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
